# MadMapper Material resources

These unmodified files come from [MadMapper-Materials](https://github.com/madmappersoftware/MadMapper-Materials/tree/d7ff211281f1878feeccd8ead05ce855c0eac5ee).

- `MadCommon.glsl`, `MadNoise.glsl` and `MadSDF.glsl` come from `Libraries/`. The source files retain their copyright and redistribution notices.
- `noiseLUT.png` comes from `Materials/Demos/SDF/_NoiseToolbox/`. The upstream Apache 2.0 license is in `LICENSE`.
- `LICENSE-webgl-noise` contains the [MIT notice](https://github.com/ashima/webgl-noise/blob/master/LICENSE) referenced by the noise implementation.
